description:
Interview Feedback Extractor turns interview feedback into clean structured fields.

It extracts strengths, risks, and suggested next steps from recruiter or interviewer notes, helping recruiting workflows stay clear and consistent.

It only structures the feedback provided by the user. It does not make hiring decisions, contact candidates, schedule interviews, update ATS systems, or provide final recruiting judgments.
